Cell labels give mean weight in kg per fish for ages 3–10. Fishery and BTS observations end in 2025; the right-hand panel includes 2026 estimates without weight observations and 2027–2028 forecasts. The solid line marks 2026; dashed boxes mark forecast years. Colours show proportional deviations from each age’s mean through 2025 within its own panel, saturating at ±50%.
